essence: Therefore, not following the prescribed measurement would result in excess.
Therefore, one should design the tips to be rounded in the fourth part, as Bhaṭṭa states.
Therefore, this eight-cornered pit is the form declared by those who know the tantras.
Therefore, after describing the pits, the text proceeds to describe the ladle and spoon.
Therefore, the teacher should select one of these specified woods for making the implements.
